newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank offers 6-mth reverse repos.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank offers 6-mth reverse repos.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Thursday started offering six-month reverse repos at a rate of 10.125 percent.

Dealers said the Central Bank may have been encouraged to sell longer-term reverse repos because of the expected increase in liquidity in the next two weeks from maturing special series T-bills and floating rate T-notes.
One dealer estimated these may add 22 billion pesos to the system.
The Central Bank's current portfolio of term reverse repos have maturities of five days, one and two months, all of which carry a rate of 9.9 percent.
